activity.role: Tragic playwright and author of the Oresteia
activity.notes: The Oresteia was presented at the City Dionysia in Athens in 458 BCE. All three surviving tragedies belong to one production and one representative Activity. The historical dramatist is distinct from the fictional Agamemnon, Orestes and other characters. Do not map the mythical Argos setting as the author's political affiliation; do not add the legendary turtle death as a verified event. Earlier military service is contextual rather than an invented command rail.
